subject: M&T CFO says AI agents are coming in every day but aren't moving deposits out yet
text:
Source: M&T Q3 call transcript https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/16/mt-bank-mtb-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/ (American Banker also covered it; source.mjs reads the transcript)
Why it fits: a named bank on AI agents and deposits; the CFO says agents are "coming in every day" but aren't moving deposits out yet. A different bank from the U.S. Bancorp brief. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
